pages.text: The $(l)T-58$() is a tactical flyer inspired by space fighters. It is a versatile unit that adapts by cycling its weapon systems in real-time.

pages.title: Hybrid Systems
pages.text: Cycles mode every $(b)20s$():$(li)$(4)Melee:$() Dives for $(6)7 Damage$().$(li)$(9)Ranged:$() Fast projectiles for $(6)5.5 Damage$().$(br2)A constant aerial threat that always pursues enemies.
A specialized build inspired by classic arcade shooters.
